$comment: Pins the code for a Manifest signature with an unregistered algorithm tag (#176 item 20). The PoP is minted normally, so the tag on `signature` is the only defect under test. The signature value is a literal: it is never verified.
description: A Manifest whose `signature` carries the algorithm tag `rsa.`, which is not in the registered set (`ed25519`, `p256`; RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3). The schema pattern for the field admits only the registered tags, so RFC-AITP-0003 §5 step 2 rejects the Manifest as a grammar failure. Receivers MUST reject with MANIFEST_INVALID, not MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_INVALID or INVALID_SIGNATURE.

expected.rationale: An unregistered algorithm tag fails the signature field's grammar, a structural defect (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3, RFC-AITP-0003 §5 step 2). It is never KEY_RESOLUTION_FAILED.
